changeinfo.changes: Added Online/offline 2 player vs AI co-op mode. Added Online/offline 2 player vs 2 player co-op mode. Added [P] symbol to score HUD to show power-play. Added online co-op difficulty choice. Added online versus difficulty choice. Added ability to select batsmen before super over. Added lofted sweep and lofted reverse sweep shots. Added advance grounded shots. Added ability to set fields in practice match, as bowler. Added ability to change difficulty in career at any point. Added ability to skip to career player at any point. Improved online gameplay experience. Improved AI run chase pacing. Improved AI running between wickets. Improved AI field placement selection. Changed time limit for looking around field. Changed score HUD from KPH to KM/H. Changed format of score HUD. Increased shot power on light defensive trigger shots. Resolved camera issues when hitting ball behind batsman in close camera. Increased minimum bowling speed for spinners. Ball no longer collides with non-striker batsman.
